learning_outcomes.text: Competently uses methods for measuring and evaluating wind characteristics.
Knows wind flow field modeling techniques.
Selects the appropriate turbine to extract energy from the wind and determines its location.
Calculates the power density and annual energy production for the selected suitable site.
Understands the performance and aerodynamic behavior of wind turbines.
Is aware of the technological trends in wind energy conversion systems.

syllabus_topics: General concepts on wind energy. The structure of atmospheric boundary layer
Measurements in the atmospheric boundary layer. Variation of wind velocity in the atmospheric boundary layer
Computation of wind power. Wind velocity and potential measuring systems
Power density function, power curves of wind turbines
Theoretical models at wind field computation. (WASP)
Theoretical models at wind field computation. Applications
